title: sparganium simplex var. gracile
intro: Sparganium simplex var. gracile, commonly known as Dwarf Bur-reed or Narrow-leaved Bur-reed, is a perennial aquatic plant species belonging to the Sparganiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, fever reduction, and as a diuretic agent. The therapeutic actions of Sparganium simplex var. gracile include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
